meta.index_type: All-Transactions House Price Index, not seasonally adjusted (index, 1995Q1=100)
meta.geography_caveat: For 13 metros FHFA publishes only the metropolitan division (MSAD), a subset of the full metro area. 'area_name' records exactly which geography each line is, and 'is_metro_division' flags it so the UI can say so.
meta.index_caveat: This is an INDEX of price change, not a price level. It answers 'how much have prices moved', never 'what does a flat cost' — that stays with the Numbeo $/m2 figure.

secondary.why: Our sf_bay_area record spans SF + San Jose; both are shown, never averaged.
